description: Predict a contract's deployment address: deployer + nonce (CREATE), or deployer (factory) + 32-byte salt + init_code or init_code_hash (CREATE2, EIP-1014). Returns the EIP-55 address. Pure, offline computation (blocktools); nothing is fetched or stored. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
name: create_address
